'''Inlow''' is the inkeeper on The [[Queen's Man]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Inlow, Master}}

==Activities==

He gives [[Rand]] and [[Mat]] a chance to play at the inn so the guests take their mind off [[Logain]]. Rand gets fevers and chills in the kitchen before they have a chance to entertain. This is a reaction to channeling two days before in [[Four Kings]]. He gives food to the boys and is prepared to offer anything else if they stay out of sight of his guests.
